idea-plugin.name: Model Switcher for Codex CLI
idea-plugin.description:
Switches the model and reasoning effort of all active Codex CLI chats through a local Codex app server, and lets you run custom Codex launch profiles from a tool window without typing shell commands.

  • One-click (or keyboard shortcut) switching between configurable model/reasoning presets
  • Open or resume a saved Codex chat from an integrated terminal
  • Custom launch profiles for Codex CLI flags outside the plugin's model presets (e.g. --profile)

Requirements: macOS only, with the Codex CLI installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/codex or /usr/local/bin/codex. The plugin only ever launches that local, verified executable and never sends keystrokes to the editor.

This plugin is an independent tool built to work with Codex CLI. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Removed the redundant manual "Server" card -- every action already starts the server lazily
  • Fixed a bug where a slow first connection could spawn a duplicate server and crash with "Address already in use"
  • Hardened recovery of an already-running server after an IDE restart
  • MODELS cards now show the live model and reasoning effort, with a distinct glyph per card
